queries: SELECT AVG(points_total) AS average_points_total, AVG(average_laps) AS average_of_average_laps FROM (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS points_total, AVG(CASE WHEN TRIM(laps) GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(laps AS REAL) END) AS average_laps FROM results WHERE grid > 12 GROUP BY driverId) AS per_driver;

SELECT AVG(points_total) AS average_points_total, AVG(average_laps) AS average_of_average_laps FROM (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS points_total, AVG(CASE WHEN TRIM(laps) GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(laps AS REAL) END) AS average_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId) AS per_driver;

WITH per_driver AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(laps, '\N'), '') AS REAL)) AS average_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_points_total, AVG(average_laps) AS average_of_average_laps FROM per_driver

WITH per_driver AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(laps, '\N'), '') AS REAL)) AS average_laps FROM results WHERE grid BETWEEN 1 AND 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_points_total, AVG(average_laps) AS average_of_average_laps FROM per_driver

WITH per_driver AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS points_total, AVG(CASE WHEN laps IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(laps) NOT IN ('', '\N') THEN CAST(laps AS REAL) END) AS average_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(points_total) AS average_points_total, AVG(average_laps) AS average_laps FROM per_driver;

assumptions.assumption: “Upwards of 12” means grid positions greater than 12; position 12 is excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: If position 12 is included, use grid positions 12 or greater.
